jobs.description: The one-time move of both price tables' vintages into their versions tables (root ADR-0317 §5.2; infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/vintage_versions.py): oldest vintage first, silver.building_register_apartment_price before silver.unit_official_price, each vintage appended as its changed keys in key-hash shards, then checked against its full copy by per-bucket checksums. A step (one shard of a vintage's write, one vintage's check) starts only while it fits the run's budget (infra/lakehouse/contracts/vintage-versions-migration.contract.json run_time_budget_seconds, measured costs per target); a written shard (its commit) and a checked vintage (the table property foundation.parity.<vintage>) are skipped by the next run, so a stopped run loses at most the step in flight. Its own job since 2026-11-04: as a unit outside this list it ran beside gold_panel_rebuild and lakehouse_maintenance, which the pool did not know it shared with, wrote one vintage in 13,226 s, spent the next 4 h 19 min in that vintage's check and was killed at 8 h with no step recorded. It holds the whole pool, so nothing else Spark runs beside it. Done when a run ends with `unit-price-versions parity=ok`, the condition of ADR-0317 stage 3.
jobs.disabled_reason: A one-time migration (root ADR-0317 stage 2), started by an operator run by run (`by-pnu-pack-operator.sh job start unit_price_versions_migration`) until a run ends with parity=ok; never scheduled.
